answer_1.quote: We conduct a holistic evaluation of LLM personalization across four task types (ranking, classification, regression, and generation), and on both short-and long-context queries.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include generated responses in ranking tasks (e.g., selecting the most persuasive reply), text generation (e.g., news headlines, scholarly titles), and personalized reasoning traces (chain-of-thoughts).

answer_2.quote: For LaMP, we follow the official metrics , and use accuracy and F1-score for classification tasks (LaMP-1 and LaMP-2), MAE and RMSE for the ordinal regression task (LaMP-3), and ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L ) for text generation tasks (LaMP-4 and LaMP-5).
